review_notes: I read the whole file. It builds on Mathlib's GroupExtension.Section and conjAct and adds three things: `normalizedExtensionSection` (a section sending 1 to 1), `factor` (a chosen N-valued two-cocycle), and the identities about them. I searched Mathlib's GroupTheory/GroupExtension directory. It has `surjInvRightHom` (an arbitrary section), `mul_mul_mul_inv_mem_range_inl` (the existence statement that `factor` is chosen from), and `exists_mul_eq_inl_mul_mul` (a similar existence statement). It has no normalized section, no chosen factor function, and no cocycle identity for nonabelian extensions. The groupCohomology cocycles are abelian-coefficient and are a different concept. The file reuses Mathlib's `S.Section`, `S.conjAct`, `inl_conjAct_comm` and `surjInvRightHom` rather than defining its own versions. I found no competing duplicate of an existing concept. I did not search Mathlib outside GroupExtension for a nonabelian cocycle; the only grep outside it was for `conjAct`, which showed Mathlib's `S.conjAct` that the file uses.
